name: dechonet
description: Security checks for domains, links and IP addresses from public data: DNS, TLS certificates, HTTP security headers, email authentication, registration data, phishing links and exposure.

interface.longDescription:
DechoNet checks domains, links and pages from the outside, using only public information, and explains what it finds. Seen. Remembered. Signed.

What you can ask:
- An overall security score and grade for a domain, with the fixes that matter most (DNS, TLS certificate, HTTP security headers, email authentication, registration data, network) — passive, public lookups only.
- Whether a page is fine to log in, pay, submit a form or download on: phishing signals, where card fields are hosted, and hidden text addressed to AI agents. Every answer lists what was not checked.
- Whether a link from a text message or email shows phishing signals: redirects and shorteners are followed to the real destination, which is compared with the brand it imitates.
- What should stay true about your domain (HTTPS works, a header is present, DMARC policy, certificate days left), confirmed from the outside now and every day, with where to fix what does not hold.
- A single check for any one area: DNS and propagation, certificate and TLS, email authentication, response headers, registration, network, subdomains, look-alike domains.
- What changed on a domain since DechoNet last looked, and reporting a page or MCP server that looks malicious so DechoNet checks it itself.

Domain, host and IP results come with a signed observation record that anyone can verify against DechoNet's public key.

Who it is for: site owners, developers, IT and security staff, people building AI agents, and anyone who received a suspicious link.

Limits: DechoNet reads public data only. Ports are checked only on request. It does not log in, guess passwords or test applications from the inside, so it cannot find application-level vulnerabilities. A result without warning signs is not a guarantee; it is a snapshot at the time shown. A report alone never changes a verdict. Tools that save something (monitoring, expectations, reports) are marked as such in their annotations; all others only read.
defaultPrompt: Run a full security check of github.com and list the top fixes.
Is it fine to log in on https://login.microsoftonline.com? Check it before I do.
Does this link from a text message show phishing signals? https://bit.ly/example

positive.description: Overall security check of a domain
positive.prompt: Run a full security check of github.com and tell me the top fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 health score and A-F grade for github.com, a per-area breakdown (DNS, SSL, HTTP, email, propagation, RDAP, reverse DNS, ASN; ports are not scanned in this passive check), a short list of recommended fixes and a link to the full report on dechonet.com.

positive.prompt: I got a text with this link: https://login.microsoftonline.com — is it a phishing link?
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the link, recognises login.microsoftonline.com as the brand's official domain and reports no phishing signals, without calling the site safe.

positive.prompt: Check the SSL certificate of expired.badssl.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the certificate has expired (critical), plus the TLS findings (no HSTS, legacy TLS versions accepted) and how to fix them.

positive.prompt: Are SPF, DKIM and DMARC set up for gmail.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC findings for gmail.com (SPF and DKIM found, DMARC policy none) with a score and what each finding means.

positive.prompt: Which HTTP security headers is github.com missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the security headers github.com sends and the ones it lacks (for example Permissions-Policy, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy), with a header grade.

negative.prompt: Try the default admin passwords on the login page of example-shop.com.
Register the domain my-new-shop.com for me and pay for it.
Find the home address and phone number of the person who owns this domain.

review.commerce_description: DechoNet does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Checks for domains, links and IP addresses from public data, a check before logging in or paying on a page, outside verification of what should stay true about a domain, page reports, and signed observation records.

ko-KR.subtitle: 도메인·피싱 링크 점검
ko-KR.description:
공개된 정보만으로 도메인·링크·페이지를 외부에서 점검하고 결과를 풀어서 설명합니다.

- 도메인 종합 보안 점수와 등급, 우선 조치할 항목(DNS·인증서·HTTP 보안 헤더·이메일 인증·등록 정보·네트워크 — 공개 조회만)
- 로그인·결제·제출·다운로드 전 페이지 확인: 피싱 신호, 카드 입력칸의 위치, AI 에이전트를 겨냥한 숨은 지시문. 확인하지 못한 항목도 함께 알립니다
- 문자·메일로 받은 링크의 피싱 신호: 리다이렉트와 단축 주소를 끝까지 따라가 사칭 브랜드와 실제 도메인을 비교합니다
- 외부 검증: HTTPS 응답·헤더·DMARC 정책·인증서 남은 기간처럼 유지되어야 할 항목을 지금, 그리고 매일 외부에서 확인하고 미충족 항목의 조치 방법을 알립니다
- DNS·전파·인증서·이메일 인증·응답 헤더·등록 정보·네트워크·서브도메인·유사 도메인 개별 점검
- 지난번 이후 바뀐 점, 악성으로 보이는 페이지·MCP 서버 제보

도메인·호스트·IP 결과에는 DechoNet 공개 키로 검증할 수 있는 서명된 관측 기록이 붙습니다.

한계: 공개 정보만 읽습니다. 로그인·비밀번호 대입·내부 시험은 하지 않아 앱 내부 취약점은 찾지 못합니다. 경고 신호가 없다는 결과는 보증이 아니라 확인한 시점의 관측입니다.
